name: Agentic Tool-Use & Structured Output (Hermes)
description: Function-calling in Hermes <tool_call> format, with categories following the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard: simple, tool selection among distractors, parallel and parallel-multiple calls, argument precision, and relevance detection (correctly declining to call when no tool fits or a required argument is missing). Graded by parsing each emitted tool call as JSON and matching its arguments individually, so a correct tool name with wrong arguments fails. Original scenarios; tune the <tools> block to your own schema.
